caption:
Growth gets stuck in twelve places. Only one of them is yours this quarter.

Demand side: acquisition, traffic, conversion, offer.
Keep side: activation, retention, churn, fulfilment.
Capacity side: capacity, utilisation, pricing, cash collection.

Working the wrong one is why effort stops turning into revenue. Growth Terminal names which is yours, prices it, and grades the call.
first_comment: Which of the twelve would you guess is yours right now?
